method: All six corrected images viewed at original detail. Road atlases show seven native crops at requested 0, 2, 4, 6, 10.5, 16.5 and 20 seconds; full views show 20 seconds.
observations: Road crops show the vehicle at different positions and apparent sizes across the 0/2/4/6-second samples in each composition, though it becomes very small or obscured in later positions.

At the 10.5-second capture the vehicle is not discernible; at 20 seconds it is visible again. The 16.5-second timing start remains behind route occlusion, so the image does not establish visible reappearance at that boundary.
Full views retain the surrounding city scene. Capture reports identical full RGBA data during two seconds of pause, resumed motion state and no page errors for all three viewports.
limitations: The six-second absence and precise 10.5/16.5 transition boundaries are timing calculations in capture.json, not direct proof of every rendered frame. The final RAF may precede a requested capture time.
Finite samples do not establish continuous movement, every occlusion or the exact visible reappearance time. Resume confirms running state rather than measured displacement.
